rule.statement: A vendor who transfers a share of land in a partition case cannot later transfer a portion of that land without reserving the right, title, and interest.
rule.supporting_quote: Therefore, having freed himself of all rights devolved on him of this 1/3rd share that he was admittedly entitled to, he could not have thereafter transferred 15 Perches by 3V1 through the Deed bearing No. 169 to the 3rd S.C. Appeal 139/2011 7 Defendant-Respondent.
